description:
CallTargetSummary.activation_inputs is merged COLUMN-WISE
(merge_summary_input_vec, jobs/semantic.rs:1976-1991, via same_call_target)
while ActivationInputRow must stay correlated (fz-9i4.7.10.2). Any
edge-carried row model needs a correlated row SET on the edge value.

PROVEN LOAD-BEARINGLY WRONG, TWICE (fz-kdt.80 builder + cold review,
2026-08-31): deleting the blend-consuming rebuild (A1) MISCOMPILES --
Enum.take([1,2,3,4,5],3) returns [1,2,3,4,5] -- and the miscompile PERSISTS
even with fz-kdt.80's join-stable key landed (key equality != emission
idempotence: rebuild_coalesced_call_emission, jobs/semantic.rs:1131-1216,
also recomputes contract return refinement, the blended surface, and the
blended-row ActivationContribution seeding the callee's ActivationInputs).

THIS TICKET therefore owns the deletions fz-kdt.80's Stage 2 could not
take: when the correlated row carrier lands, merge_summary_input_vec, the
column-wise blend, and rebuild_coalesced_call_emission die IN THE SAME
MOTION (rip-out law), and fz-kdt.90's merge_callsite_activation dead-arm
check folds into the cleanup.

## Sequencing (2026-08-31)
Shared substrate under BOTH live routes (a resumed fz-kdt.69.3 and any
future cell model) -- not speculative. Requires fz-kdt.80's Stage-1 dedupe
first (join-stable keys make row identity meaningful across coalescing).
Acceptance: edge value carries rows; artifact byte-identical (measure
against the post-kdt.80 baseline); pins hold. STOP: if carrying rows
changes the demanded key set, that is the artifact-vs-precision tension
surfacing (fz-kdt.74 item 5) -- stop and decide the artifact question
explicitly.
